purpose: Freeze representative History Fit expectations before the merged v1.8 candidate library exists, so retrieval and boundary tests cannot be tailored after observing v1.8 outputs.

retrievalCases.scenario: Current handicap supports a pitcher strikeout over from opponent strikeout tendency, confirmed lineup and expected workload. History Fit is asked whether the historical research strengthens that already-formed candidate.
requiredConcepts: expected batters faced or workload/hook risk
forbiddenClaims: historical research proves the over is profitable
the mechanism study supplies an executable strikeout price
the 2026 market audit creates a universal over/under adjustment

retrievalCases.scenario: Current handicap likes an anytime-home-run candidate because of contact quality, park and matchup, while recent home-run streaks are also visible.
requiredConcepts: no broad historical home-run pricing correction survived holdout
forbiddenClaims: recent home runs alone validate the prop
Statcast is sportsbook calibration evidence
History Fit should automatically shade the fair price

retrievalCases.scenario: A current batting-walk prop has already passed the live handicap. History Fit evaluates the limited 2026 direct-market calibration evidence.
requiredConcepts: market-specific signal rather than universal correction
forbiddenClaims: the historical adjustment is an executable betting rule
the same adjustment transfers to strikeouts, hits, home runs or total bases
one partial season merits A-grade confidence

retrievalCases.scenario: A player SOG over is supported by expected ice time, line role, power-play role and opponent shot context.
requiredConcepts: forecastability is not direct closing-price calibration
recording/rink effects are cautionary rather than a fixed adjustment
forbiddenClaims: SOG forecastability proves sportsbook mispricing
a historical rink adjustment should be applied mechanically in 2026
History Fit supplies the play-to price

retrievalCases.scenario: A goalie saves over is being justified mainly by the goalie's recent save-percentage hot streak rather than expected shot volume.
requiredConcepts: shot volume and save probability must be separated
forbiddenClaims: recent save percentage is persistent edge evidence
the hot-hand study calibrates sportsbook saves lines
research should raise stake because of the streak

retrievalCases.scenario: An anytime-goal candidate is supported by shooter quality, expected role and opposing goalie context.
forbiddenClaims: xG research proves the posted anytime-goal price is wrong
mechanism evidence is a second independent betting signal
research may rewrite fair value

retrievalCases.scenario: A receiving-yards over is supported by target opportunity, route role, catch probability and defender context. Direct multi-book sportsbook calibration remains unverified.
requiredConcepts: target opportunity separated from catch probability
forbiddenClaims: tracking research proves sportsbook mispricing
the gap is negative predictive evidence
NFL mechanism evidence deserves A-grade direct-market confidence

retrievalCases.scenario: A spread moves across 3 and the proposed explanation is that the move must represent informed or sharp money.
requiredConcepts: movement can reflect demand/order flow rather than private information
forbiddenClaims: crossing 3 proves sharp information
all steam is informative
the research dictates a side to bet

retrievalCases.scenario: A mid-to-late-season NFL candidate leans heavily on preseason expectations despite substantial current-season evidence.
requiredConcepts: preseason anchors can persist in bettor behavior and closing prices
preseason expectations are context rather than independent current-value evidence
forbiddenClaims: preseason rating persistence proves value
historical anchoring automatically identifies the correct side

retrievalCases.scenario: An assists prop is supported by minutes, role and usage assumptions. History Fit evaluates NBA stat-specific forecastability and available closing-prop context.
requiredConcepts: single-book direct-market evidence does not show a universal directional bias
player-specific models are mechanism rather than sportsbook price evidence
forbiddenClaims: NBA props have a universal over or under bias
DFS forecasting success proves sportsbook value
single-book thesis evidence merits A-grade market confidence

retrievalCases.scenario: A candidate is being supported primarily because a commercial or third-party projection provider agrees with it.
requiredConcepts: professional projections can improve on naive forecasts only modestly
third-party projection is an input rather than an independent sharp signal
forbiddenClaims: commercial projection agreement is an extra betting vote
projection-provider consensus can override current fair value

retrievalCases.scenario: A WNBA points or assists prop has a current handicap, but direct WNBA closing-price calibration evidence is requested.
requiredConcepts: NBA evidence must not be inherited automatically
forbiddenClaims: NBA closing-prop evidence directly validates WNBA prices
the WNBA gap predicts the candidate will lose
an indirect NBA analogy upgrades direct WNBA confidence above NR

retrievalCases.scenario: A soccer candidate compares 1X2 pricing with Asian-handicap market behavior for the same match.
requiredConcepts: 1X2 and Asian handicap should not be treated as interchangeable price surfaces
forbiddenClaims: the numerical effect transfers automatically to North American sports
one market structure is universally sharper

retrievalCases.scenario: A multi-leg NFL wager has passed its current leg-level handicap and History Fit is asked what historical market structure says about the product.
requiredConcepts: large historical hold does not define a specific wager's fair price
forbiddenClaims: apply a fixed historical haircut to all parlays
historical sportsbook hold supplies the fair price
research should create or size the parlay

retrievalCases.scenario: A current candidate is being upgraded simply because the market moved in the same direction as the selection.
requiredConcepts: order flow and demand can move prices
movement is informative but not a pure informed-money signal
forbiddenClaims: steam equals sharp truth
all reversals should be faded
History Fit may silently blend today's move into the historical grade

boundaryCases.condition: The same DOI/source is reachable through multiple logical items or clusters.
boundaryCases.expected: Count the source once; synthesis/cluster membership must not create an additional evidence vote.

boundaryCases.condition: A player-performance mechanism study is presented as proof that the sportsbook price is wrong.
boundaryCases.expected: Reject the market-mispricing inference; mechanism may support/caution History Fit but cannot become direct market-calibration evidence.

boundaryCases.condition: NBA direct player-prop evidence is offered as direct WNBA calibration evidence.
boundaryCases.expected: Do not inherit direct-market confidence; WNBA direct calibration remains NR unless direct WNBA evidence exists.

boundaryCases.condition: An explicit research gap is treated as evidence against a candidate.
boundaryCases.expected: Return NR/insufficient evidence rather than a negative predictive conclusion.

boundaryCases.condition: History Fit attempts to change bet status, fair value, model error, play-to price or stake.
boundaryCases.expected: Hard-boundary failure. Preserve the already-formed current handicap and reject the research-side mutation.

boundaryCases.condition: Research attempts to supply an executable sportsbook price or create a wager that did not already exist.
boundaryCases.expected: Hard-boundary failure. Research cannot create a bet or executable price.

boundaryCases.condition: The research library or retrieval layer is unavailable.
boundaryCases.expected: Render HISTORY LIBRARY UNAVAILABLE; core analysis may proceed if all non-research gates pass.

boundaryCases.condition: A superficially similar but wrong-sport or wrong-market prior ranks above an exact available prior.
boundaryCases.expected: Fail retrieval ordering. Exact sport + exact market + timing/mechanism must outrank generic analogy.

boundaryCases.condition: Today's line movement or personal ledger performance is silently blended into the History Fit grade.
boundaryCases.expected: Hard-boundary failure. Same-day movement and personal ledger data may not be silently incorporated into the historical research grade.
